description: This file contains a set of unit tests for the HomePageService class in the OrangeHRM project. It verifies that the service correctly retrieves default page paths for various modules by mocking dependencies such as BasicUserRoleManager. It is part of the testing suite for core service components.

classes.name: HomePageServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class that verifies the behavior of the HomePageService methods, ensuring correct default page paths are returned based on mocked user roles.

methods.name: testGetHomePagePath
methods.description: Tests that HomePageService correctly retrieves the homepage path using BasicUserRoleManager.

methods.name: testGetModuleDefaultPage
methods.description: Verifies that the default page for the 'admin' module is correctly obtained.

methods.name: testGetTimeModuleDefaultPath
methods.description: Checks that the default path for the 'time' module is correctly retrieved.

methods.name: testGetLeaveModuleDefaultPath
methods.description: Ensures the leave module default path is correctly fetched.

methods.name: testGetAdminModuleDefaultPath
methods.description: Verifies that the admin module default path is correctly returned.

methods.name: testGetPimModuleDefaultPath
methods.description: Checks the correct retrieval of the PIM module default path.

methods.name: testGetRecruitmentModuleDefaultPath
methods.description: Verifies that the recruitment module default path is correctly fetched.

methods.name: testGetPerformanceModuleDefaultPath
methods.description: Ensures that if the user role manager returns null for the performance module, the service correctly returns null.
